meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用 CDP 控制浏览器，复用登录态提取所需数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要用脚本控制 Chrome 完成自动化操作
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to reuse logins and extract data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可通过 CDP 协议控制本机 Chrome,复用你已有的登录状态:打开网页、等待加载、执行 JavaScript、提取页面文本和登录令牌,还能用快照定位元素模拟点击与输入。首次启动会先征得你同意再接管浏览器。
howto.when: 当你提到「浏览器自动化」「操作浏览器」「复用登录态」等关键词,或要求通过 CDP 控制 Chrome、从浏览器提取登录令牌时触发。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 https://example.com,等它加载完
say.note: 会先探测 CDP 状态,再启动或复用调试 Chrome。

say.text: 从当前浏览器的登录态里提取认证 token
用 CDP 数一下当前页面有多少个链接

howto.what_en: Claude controls Chrome via CDP, reusing your login sessions: opens URLs, waits for load, evaluates JS, extracts text and auth tokens, clicks/types via snapshots. First launch asks consent before taking over your browser.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like browser automation, CDP, 浏览器操作, 复用登录态, or ask to control Chrome via CDP and reuse an existing login session / extract auth tokens.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com via CDP and wait for it to load.
say_en.note: It probes CDP status first, then starts or reuses the debug Chrome.

say_en.text: Extract the auth token from the current browser login session.
say_en.note: It reads localStorage or cookies and returns the value.

say_en.text: Count how many links are on the current page via CDP.
say_en.note: For JS with quotes/symbols it falls back to base64 or stdin eval.
